notes.content:
Dear players, Infinite Tao has been fully released, Thanks for your support. I will continue to update.

Elixir
- Remove Wind Elixir
- New Green Dragon Elixir, White Tiger Elixir, Vermilion Bird Elixir, Black Tortoise Elixir (Effect: Can't reroll certain synergie Magic Treasures and Get Spiritual Energy)

Character
